blocks.text: We are writing to confirm that we have received a referral for you from the Department of Cardiology at St Saviour's Hospital. Your name has been added to the waiting list for a routine outpatient appointment with Renal Services.

rows: Department of Cardiology, St Saviour's Hospital
Approximately six weeks from the date of referral
To be confirmed - not yet booked

blocks.text: The current waiting time for a routine appointment in this service is approximately six weeks from the date of referral. We will write to you again with the date, time and location of your appointment as soon as it has been booked. Please do not come to the hospital until you have received that letter.
If you have not heard from us by 23 June 2026, please telephone the booking office on 01632 960118, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, quoting the reference number at the top of this letter.

Please let us know as soon as possible if your address, telephone number or GP practice changes, or if there are dates on which you would be unable to attend. If you no longer wish to be seen, please tell us so that we can offer the appointment to another patient.
This letter confirms only that your referral has been received and that you are on the waiting list. It is not an appointment.
